metric: Pairs the authors' run flagged unequal: 214 because the results differed, 197 because the rewrite failed to run, 85 because a query timed out, and the 2 documented TPC-H Q2 rewrites. Refuted means DuckDB returns different bags on a replayed database that respects the schema (by flag reason: 153 rows, 14 error, 35 timeout, 2 documented). A proof with a replayed difference would be wrong.
correctness: 0 wrong (a proof with a replayed difference). Of the 31 proofs, 14 rely on the prover's stated assumption that rows tied on ORDER BY are cut by LIMIT alike, where the authors' run saw tie-breaking; the others were flagged for a timeout or a failed run, not for different rows
caveats: A flag of unequal is not a semantic label: timeouts and rewrites that failed to run are flagged too, so only replayed differences count as negatives. Refutations come from KumoSQL's own databases (the authors' instances are not public; TPC-H also runs on a generated scale-0.01 instance, and a difference there counts only if the unoptimized plan finishes in 30 s and agrees). Data downloaded at a pinned commit. The rules written on 2026-11-10 for the flagged-equal development pairs also prove 5 development pairs flagged only for a timeout (20 to 25 proofs); each was read by hand and is equivalent as written (a correlated average decorrelated into a grouped join, comma joins written as JOIN). The rules written on 2026-11-12 for the TPC-H, Calcite and SQLStorm development pairs prove 6 more pairs flagged only for a failed run or a timeout (25 to 31 proofs: 2 TPC-H pairs flagged for a timeout and 1 for a failed run, TPC-H Q20 and Q11 rewrites with the same rows as written, and 3 Calcite window-function rewrites whose output alias is spelled with a digit); each was read by hand and is equivalent as written. On 2026-11-11 the directed search of tools/witness_search.py added refutations (134 refuted on 2026-11-10, 204 now; a rerun of main in the same container as this run refutes 114). The database search has an 8 s budget per pair, so a refutation near that limit is not found in every run. The held-out pairs were never read one by one.
